title: Add sober:auto to the agent plugins and document its use
name: auto-skill
description: Add plugins/skills/auto/SKILL.md as the source, generate all four host variants with pnpm plugins, and document an explicit sober:auto invocation, one-node scope, the board-wide decision gate, answered-decision lookup and the threshold for pausing on a new cross-node choice.
